title: Orthotropic Extensions of Anisotropic Creep-Damage Models
exact_target: Extend anisotropic creep-damage models to orthotropic materials, accelerating creep, and practical parameter identification.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000397 (OWR-1186-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mechanics of Materials (2006), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2006/04, pp. 187--252; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF source context inspected in report 1186.

status_qualification: All three modeling tasks remain part of the question. The short extract does not give one universal constitutive family, experiment, error metric, or parameter range, so this is a research program rather than a quantified theorem for arbitrary materials.
